sources.review: Printed pp. 1-5: legacy black housing with two metal top panels, raised rear detector enclosure, upper sample port, front selector and purge connector, diffuse gold reference and protective cap. Figure 1 photograph inspected; 76.2 mm sphere and 18 mm sample port are explicit. Accessory-specific bottom alignment pin and detector cable installation are described.

vendor_resource_search.result: Model-specific manufacturer manual and photographs found; no downloadable vendor CAD located in these searches.

variant_resolution: The paper names Mid-IR IntegratIR without specifying detector or generation. The task selects this documented legacy room-temperature DLaTGS configuration as an inference.
Do not combine the 2012 18 mm port and black housing with the later 2013 gold-front 12-degree 23.5 mm port housing or an MCT Dewar.
inferences: 175 x 195 x 165 mm main assembly envelope is selected from photograph proportions and sample-bay fit; not a dimension from this manual.
Shell profiles, detector enclosure, selector and purge connector dimensions, alignment pin and reference holder/cap dimensions are inferred.
Detector connector contact count, exact family and wiring are unresolved; the asset contains a recessed connector envelope without asserting a pinout or mating compatibility.
Internal sphere position and wall thickness are selected around the source 76.2 mm cavity; optical paths are illustrative and unqualified.
